protocol.labels: Terminal labels only; observable episode reset and query boundary; no intermediate labels.
protocol.candidate_library: All reachable minimal binary DFAs with <=3 states, canonical BFS state names.
protocol.enumeration_privilege: Supplied correct state-count bound in main family; becomes false in four-state control.
protocol.merging_privilege: Supplied deterministic finite-state language, binary encoding, terminal alignment, observed reset boundary; no state-count bound.
protocol.corruption: 32 distinct sampled terminal labels flipped; no word duplicated, so deterministic consistency remains possible.
protocol.evaluation: Truth and product-graph witnesses never passed to learners; no learning during held-out evaluation.
protocol.configuration: Single specified configuration; full experiment not tuned on held-out outcomes.
protocol.intervals: Descriptive normal intervals over independent sampled lives within each regime; no simultaneous significance claim.
limitations: Refits occur only at observed episode boundaries
